payload.description: A tiny UNIVERSAL bare-bones remains prop for a dark fantasy pixel-art tactics game. Simple chunky crisp native 64x64 pixel art, low detail, muted dirty ivory and taupe bone, purple-gray shadows, selective charcoal outline, top-left light. Shallow three-quarter overhead camera. Flat on the ground, overall occupied footprint about 48x28 pixels. Anonymous thick bone fragments: impossible to identify human or monster. NO skull, head, face, jaw, teeth, claws, horns, hands, feet, tall plate, upright bone, complete skeleton, flesh, blood, clothing, soil, pedestal or background. No blur, glow or smooth illustration. Transparent RGBA. TWO DISTINCT SMALL CLUSTERS lying side by side, each made of only THREE short bone fragments. A clearly empty 8-pixel gap separates the clusters. Wide low shape. Nothing in the gap, no single central heap.
